organization of extracellular matrix in the marginal zone involved in cerebral cortex glial-mediated radial migration

definition: The process that leads to the deposition of extracellular matrix signals in the marginal zone of the developing cerebral cortex. This extracellular matrix controls the movement of migrating cells. In mammals, the matrix is modified by Cajal-Retzius cells.
